title: Generate native 30-second videos in a single Seedance 2.5 generation for…
content:
Generate native 30-second videos in a single Seedance 2.5 generation for long-take shots without stitching.

Use Long Video Mode to create consistent videos up to 3 minutes when you need continuity across extended sequences.

Use the interactive editing tool with precise timestamp control (down to 1 second) to reshape/edit specific parts of the frame at exact moments.

Provide up to 50 multimodal references to steer style/characters/scene consistency, including support for 3D white models and green-screen assets.

Integrate Seedance 2.5 into film/VFX pipelines via the Dreamina AI Maya and Blender plugins for production-ready workflows.
